name: Handmade merino wool hats and gloves online store: launch plan and first-year costs
about: Launching an online store with hand-knitted merino wool hats and gloves: own store plus a handmade marketplace and craft fairs, made by the owner and two home knitters paid per piece. Assumes opening in early autumn: months 1-3 are the peak season, months 4-12 include the off-season, used to knit stock, sell to boutiques and take custom orders. Four phases: Analysis, Implementation, a 3-month launch period with a bigger launch promotion and higher costs, and operation for months 4-12. Prices in US dollars. days = the owner's or team's project work in man-days (the editor turns it into labor cost as days x rate); capex = fixed assets bought (equipment, furniture, hardware); opex = operating outlays (rent, wages, stock, platform fees, marketing). Costs only: no revenue, and no ongoing stock reorders, payment fees or shipping costs, since they depend on sales.
